api.name: engine
api.description: The shared sprite engine seen from Lua. Every module is a global table; value types (vec2, rect, color, purse, camera, text style, input) are Lua tables with a metatable, so `r:cut_top(66)` and `a + b` work and `{x = 1, y = 2}` is a valid vec2 - as in C, zero is the default for every field left out. Stateful objects (a city, a save file being read) are userdata handles with methods. Functions keep the names and the argument order of engine.h, minus their type prefix.

struct.name: vec2
struct.doc: A point or offset.

struct.name: size2
struct.doc: A width and height.

struct.name: rect
struct.doc: An axis-aligned rectangle: top-left corner and size.

struct.name: color
struct.doc: 8-bit RGBA. `color(r, g, b)` is opaque; see color.hex.

struct.name: purse
struct.doc: An amount of each resource: a sequence of up to purse.MAX integers (missing ones are 0). The game names the slots: `local COINS, INFLUENCE = 1, 2`.

module.name: num
module.doc: Scalar helpers the engine uses everywhere; `math` has the rest.

function.name: clamp
function.doc: v limited to [lo, hi].

function.name: clampi
function.doc: Integer clamp.

function.name: saturate
function.doc: v limited to [0, 1].

function.name: lerp
function.doc: a + (b - a) * t.

function.name: smoothstep
function.doc: Hermite ramp from 0 at a to 1 at b.

function.name: approach
function.doc: Frame-rate independent exponential approach of cur towards target.

function.name: out_back
function.doc: Overshoots a little before settling.

module.name: vec2
module.doc: Constructor `vec2(x, y)`; operators + - * (by a number or component-wise) and unary minus; every function is also a method.

function.name: mul
function.doc: Component-wise product.

function.name: div
function.doc: Component-wise quotient.

function.name: norm
function.doc: Unit length, or the zero vector unchanged.

function.name: polar
function.doc: A vector of length len at angle (radians).

function.name: approach
function.doc: Exponential approach of cur towards target.

function.name: ellipse
function.doc: Squared length of a in units of the ellipse radii r: at most 1 means inside.

function.name: iso
function.doc: Isometric projection of a ground point (x, y) with height z to a screen offset.

function.name: vec
function.doc: As a vec2 (w, h).

function.name: of
function.doc: From a vec2.

function.name: aspect
function.doc: w / h.

function.name: fit
function.doc: Scale factor that fits inner entirely inside outer (contain).

function.name: cover
function.doc: Scale factor that makes inner fill all of outer.

module.name: rect
module.doc: Constructor `rect(x, y, w, h)`. Layout is RectCut: `rect.cut_top(r, 66)` slices 66 units off the top of r (changing r) and returns the slice.

function.name: corners
function.doc: The rect spanned by two points.

function.name: pos
function.doc: Top-left corner.

function.name: max
function.doc: Bottom-right corner.

function.name: point
function.doc: Point at normalised coordinates inside r: (0,0) top-left, (1,1) bottom-right.

function.name: anchor
function.doc: Rect of size whose pivot (normalised) sits on point.

function.name: align
function.doc: Place size inside outer with normalised alignment (0.5, 0.5 = centre).

function.name: inflate
function.doc: Grow by d on every side (negative shrinks).

function.name: inflate2
function.doc: Grow by d.x horizontally and d.y vertically.

function.name: scale
function.doc: Scaled about its centre.

function.name: resize
function.doc: New size keeping the point at pivot in place.

function.name: fit
function.doc: The largest rect of inner's aspect centred in outer.

function.name: ellipse_contains
function.doc: Whether p is inside the ellipse inscribed in r.

function.name: cut_left
function.doc: Slice a units off the left of r, shrinking r.

function.name: left
function.doc: The left a units of r, r unchanged.

function.name: col
function.doc: Column i (0-based) of n equal columns separated by gap.

function.name: row
function.doc: Row i (0-based) of n equal rows separated by gap.

module.name: color
module.doc: Constructor `color(r, g, b, a)`; `color.hex(0xRRGGBB)`; constants WHITE, BLACK, CLEAR.

function.name: hex
function.doc: Opaque colour from 0xRRGGBB.

function.name: alpha
function.doc: c with its alpha multiplied by a (0..1).

function.name: shade
function.doc: RGB multiplied by k, alpha kept.

function.name: covers
function.doc: Whether have has at least need of everything.

module.name: app
module.doc: The window, the logical screen and the main loop. A game's main.lua returns the descriptor engine.h calls app_desc - `return {title = ..., id = ..., design = size2(1200, 900), max_aspect = 16 / 9, landscape = true, fixed = false, rotate_text = ..., clear = color.hex(0x0E2B2E), init = function() end, frame = function(dt) end, quit = function() end}` - and the engine runs it (fixed keeps the design size and letterboxes the rest; a fixed game with a max_aspect still grows along its long side up to that ratio, so read app.screen() for its height): init once the window exists, frame every frame, quit at the end. Command line options understood by every game: --size WxH, --fresh (no saves), --data DIR, --lua DIR, --shot out.png [--frames N].

function.name: quit
function.doc: End the main loop after this frame.

function.name: screen
function.doc: The logical screen, origin (0, 0).

function.name: bleed
function.doc: The whole display in logical units: the screen plus letterbox bars and safe-area margins (x and y may be negative). Draw backgrounds over it inside gfx.bleed(true); keep controls in app.screen().

function.name: pixel_scale
function.doc: Device pixels per logical unit.

function.name: time
function.doc: Seconds since start (frame time).

function.name: dt
function.doc: Duration of the current frame, seconds.

function.name: clock
function.doc: Wall clock, seconds since the Unix epoch.

function.name: arg
function.doc: Value after --name on the command line (or in the web page's query string): the value, "" for a bare flag, nil if absent.

function.name: path
function.doc: An asset path resolved against the data root.

function.name: renderer_geometry
function.doc: Draw coloured triangles: pts and colors have one entry per vertex, indices three per triangle (0-based). Lives here because it talks to the renderer directly.

function.name: inject_click
function.doc: Queue a press and release at a logical point, as a tap would. For automated tests only.

function.name: web_storage
function.doc: On the web, the value of localStorage[key], else nil. For migrating saves from older builds.

struct.name: input
struct.doc: A snapshot of the pointer (mouse or first finger) with gestures. `input{pos = p, pinch = 1}` is an idle pointer at p.

field.name: press_pos
field.doc: Where the current or last press started.

field.name: dragging
field.doc: Moved further than the drag threshold.

field.name: captured
field.doc: The press started on UI; the world should ignore it.

field.name: hover
field.doc: A real mouse is over the window.

field.name: pinch
field.doc: Zoom factor from two fingers this frame (1 = none).

field.name: key
field.doc: AX key code pressed this frame, 0 if none.

field.name: back
field.doc: Escape or the Android back button.

function.name: get
function.doc: This frame's pointer.

function.name: world
function.doc: The same, with pointer actions cleared when UI owns the press: what cameras, boards and cities consume.

struct.name: texture
struct.doc: A loaded image; `w` and `h` are its pixel size. Textures are never freed by the collector.

function.name: load
function.doc: PNG, JPG or BMP relative to the data root. A missing file gives a texture with tex = nil and size 0.

function.name: from_pixels
function.doc: From raw RGBA bytes, w * h * 4 of them.

function.name: additive
function.doc: Switch the texture between additive and normal blending.

module.name: gfx
module.doc: Shapes and images, in logical screen units, drawn in call order.

function.name: image
function.doc: Draw t stretched to dst, multiplied by tint (color.WHITE for none).

function.name: image_part
function.doc: Draw the src part of t (in pixels) stretched to dst.

function.name: image_rot
function.doc: Draw t rotated by angle (radians) about the centre of dst.

function.name: rect_grad
function.doc: Vertical gradient.

function.name: round_rect_line
function.doc: Outline only.

function.name: shadow
function.doc: A blurred drop shadow under a rounded rect.

function.name: glow
function.doc: A radial gradient from inner at the centre to outer at the rim.

function.name: poly
function.doc: A filled convex polygon.

function.name: ngon
function.doc: A regular polygon; angle rotates it (radians).

function.name: star
function.doc: A star with `points` points; inner is the inner radius as a ratio of radius.

function.name: additive
function.doc: Additive blending for shapes (glows, sparks) until switched off.

function.name: clip
function.doc: Draw only inside r until unclip.

function.name: bleed
function.doc: While on, drawing may reach the whole display (app.bleed()), not only the logical screen: for full-bleed backgrounds. Resets any clip.

struct.name: camera
struct.doc: A view rect on screen looking at a world of `world` size. Functions return a new camera: `cam = cam:input(in):clamp()`.

field.name: center
field.doc: World point at the middle of the view.

field.name: view
field.doc: Where the camera draws on screen.

field.name: cover
field.doc: Never show outside the world (else centre small worlds).

function.name: visible
function.doc: The world rect currently in view.

function.name: fit_zoom
function.doc: The zoom at which the whole world fits the view.

function.name: clamp
function.doc: Zoom within its limits and the view inside the world.

function.name: zoom_at
function.doc: Multiply the zoom by factor keeping the world point under screen_point still.

function.name: look
function.doc: Centre on a world point.

function.name: input
function.doc: Apply drag, wheel and pinch.

function.name: draw_texture
function.doc: Draw a world-sized backdrop, only the visible part.

module.name: fx
module.doc: Pooled particles and floating text in screen space.

function.name: burst
function.doc: count sparks flying out from pos.

function.name: text
function.doc: Text that rises and fades.

function.name: sparkle
function.doc: A ring of twinkles.

function.name: load
function.doc: A .ttf relative to the data root.

function.name: set_fallback
function.doc: Glyphs missing from f come from fallback.

struct.name: text_style
struct.doc: How text is drawn. Only font and size are needed; zero means off. `style{font = f, size = 17, fill = color.hex(0xF4E8CA)}`.

field.name: fill
field.doc: Top colour (defaults to white when left out).

field.name: fill2
field.doc: Bottom colour for a vertical gradient.

module.name: style
module.doc: Constructor `style{...}`; the methods return a tweaked copy.

function.name: filled
function.doc: A flat fill colour.

module.name: text
module.doc: Styled TrueType text. Every function returns the rect it drew.

function.name: draw
function.doc: One line with its pivot (0,0 top-left .. 1,1 bottom-right) at pos.

function.name: box
function.doc: Word-wrapped text aligned inside box, lines balanced in length; shrinks the font (down to 60%) if it would not fit.

function.name: box_reveal
function.doc: text.box showing only the first visible codepoints, every line already in its final place.

function.name: box_size
function.doc: Wrapped size at that width.

function.name: length
function.doc: Length in codepoints.

function.name: ink
function.doc: Visible ink of one line, relative to where text.draw with pivot (0,0) puts its box.

function.name: in_
function.doc: One line placed by its visible ink: aligned inside box and shrunk to fit it. Optical centring for buttons, counters and badges.

function.name: fit
function.doc: A single line that shrinks to fit the box width.

module.name: sfx
module.doc: A tiny synthesiser for feedback tones.

function.name: tone
function.doc: A soft bell-like note.

struct.name: ui_theme
struct.doc: Colours and text styles the widgets read.

struct.name: ui_state
struct.doc: How an area was interacted with this frame.

module.name: ui
module.doc: Immediate-mode widgets: call them while drawing, `if ui.button(r, 'Play') then`.

function.name: set_theme
function.doc: The theme every widget reads from now on.

function.name: theme
function.doc: The current theme (a copy).

function.name: block
function.doc: Mark r as UI so world input ignores presses on it.

function.name: hit
function.doc: Raw interaction of an area.

function.name: button_frame
function.doc: Background only; draw your own content.

function.name: button
function.doc: True when clicked.

function.name: progress
function.doc: A themed meter; fraction is clamped to 0..1.

function.name: toast
function.doc: A short message at the bottom of the screen.

function.name: modal_backdrop
function.doc: Dim everything drawn so far and block input outside dialogs; t fades it in.

function.name: set_enabled
function.doc: While false, widgets draw but ignore input (under a modal).

struct.name: sprite_frame
struct.doc: One trimmed atlas frame with a normalized pivot.

module.name: sprite
module.doc: Authored atlas frames, pivot-aware bounds and animation timing.

struct.name: nav_blocker
struct.doc: A live circular obstacle; radius zero disables it.

handle.name: nav
handle.doc: A geometric route graph, independent of any game. Array assignment checks capacity.

module.name: nav
module.doc: nav.new(); assign nodes and live blockers, then find. Indices are 0-based.

function.name: find
function.doc: Shortest route; false clears path. Exempts one blocker (default -1). Optional ellipse stops at the target footprint.

handle.name: save
handle.doc: A save file being read or written. The same visitor function does both: `wallet = s:ints('wallet', wallet)` loads the value when reading and stores it when writing.

function.name: read
function.doc: Call fn(s) with s reading the slot; false if no save exists.

function.name: write
function.doc: Call fn(s) with s writing the slot.

function.name: int
function.doc: The stored value when reading, else v, which is stored.

function.name: ints
function.doc: A sequence of integers; its length decides how many are read.

function.name: inject
function.doc: Use text produced elsewhere as the source of the next save.read of slot (a migration).

struct.name: character
struct.doc: Someone who speaks.

field.name: id
field.doc: How scripts refer to the character.

field.name: right
field.doc: Stands on the right of the dialogue.

field.name: mouth
field.doc: Where they speak from, 0..1 inside the portrait (default .5, .25).

struct.name: story_line
struct.doc: `{who, text, kind}` (positional or named); who is a character id, nil for the narrator.

struct.name: story_style
struct.doc: How dialogue looks.

field.name: framed
field.doc: Portraits are busts: show them in a medallion.

field.name: skip
field.doc: Label of a skip button, nil for none.

function.name: setup
function.doc: The game's cast (a sequence of characters) and how its dialogue looks; call once after loading fonts.

function.name: character
function.doc: A character by id, or nil.

function.name: play
function.doc: Queue a beat once per save: false (and nothing queued) if it was seen before.

function.name: say
function.doc: Queue one spoken line, every time.

function.name: add
function.doc: Queue one line of any kind.

function.name: active
function.doc: Whether a dialogue is running (hold your own input).

function.name: next
function.doc: Move on, as a tap would.

function.name: frame
function.doc: Draw the dialogue over everything and take all input while it runs; call last in the frame.

function.name: serialize
function.doc: Beats seen, inside a save visitor.

function.name: forget
function.doc: New game: nothing seen.

function.name: bubble_shape
function.doc: A bubble around box pointing at tip.

function.name: bubble
function.doc: A bubble with text above tip (below when there is no room), kept on screen. Returns its rect.

struct.name: building_def
struct.doc: A building type.

field.name: height
field.doc: Drawn height in world units (width keeps the aspect)...

field.name: max_height
field.doc: Cap for a height derived from width (0 = none).

field.name: sink
field.doc: How far the sprite bottom sits below the anchor point.

field.name: footprint
field.doc: Half extents of the ground diamond; zero = a circle of city.spacing.

field.name: needs
field.doc: Must be owned (not spent) to build.

struct.name: building
struct.doc: A placed building.

struct.name: city_zone
struct.doc: A region of the map that opens as a whole.

field.name: area
field.doc: Used when the city has no zone_at callback.

struct.name: city_event
struct.doc: What a city update or confirm did.

field.name: building
field.doc: Index of the building involved, or -1.

handle.name: city
handle.doc: The building meta-game: ground, zones, a catalogue of building types and the placed buildings. Fields read and write the engine's state; struct-valued fields are copied, so `local cam = c.cam; cam.view = r; c.cam = cam`. Callbacks receive the city as their first argument.

field.name: defs
field.doc: The building catalogue; assign a sequence.

field.name: open
field.doc: Bit per opened zone (bit 0 = zone 0, which starts open).

field.name: spacing
field.doc: Minimum distance between buildings without footprints.

field.name: tile
field.doc: Isometric tile half extents; defaults to 32 x 16. Placement snaps to tile centres.

field.name: buildable
field.decl: bool lcity_buildable(const struct city *c, vec2 world)

field.name: zone_at
field.decl: int lcity_zone_at(const struct city *c, vec2 world)
field.doc: function(c, world) -> zone (0-based) or -1; default: zone rects.

field.name: zone_touches
field.decl: bool lcity_zone_touches(const struct city *c, int zone, unsigned open)
field.doc: function(c, zone, open) -> bool: adjacency; default: rects touching.

field.name: draw_over
field.doc: function(c): game drawing above the fog and buildings, below the ghost.

field.name: movable
field.doc: Drag a building to move it.

field.name: selected
field.doc: Quick build: a tap places this type at once (-1 = off).

field.name: moving
field.doc: Index being moved, -1 = a new building.

module.name: city
module.doc: `city.new()` makes one; configure its fields, then `c:init(ground)`.

value.name: BUILT
value.doc: A new building was placed and paid for.

value.name: BLOCKED
value.doc: The spot is not free, not land or not open.

value.name: LOCKED_TYPE
value.doc: The building's needs are not met.

value.name: ZONE
value.doc: Tapped land in a closed zone (event.zone).

function.name: init
function.doc: Load the ground and the building sprites and fill in defaults.

function.name: can_place
function.doc: ignore: a building index to skip, or -1.

function.name: find_spot
function.doc: The nearest free spot to hint: ok, spot.

function.name: add
function.doc: Place without checks or payment; returns the index or -1.

function.name: ready
function.doc: Whether building index has income to collect.

function.name: sprite_rect
function.doc: World rect of a building's sprite.

function.name: zone_at
function.doc: The zone containing a world point, or -1.

function.name: zone_available
function.doc: Closed, touching open land and affordable.

function.name: unlock
function.doc: Open a zone, paying from wallet; false if not available.

function.name: next_zone
function.doc: The first available zone, else the first closed touching one, else -1.

function.name: snap
function.doc: The isometric tile centre nearest a world point: where a dropped ghost lands.

function.name: begin_place
function.doc: Start a placement session with a ghost at `at`.

function.name: confirm
function.doc: Build or move the ghost, paying from wallet.

function.name: update
function.doc: Camera, gestures, quick build and collecting; wallet pays and receives.

function.name: serialize
function.doc: Buildings and open zones, inside a save visitor.
